title: Nature Sounds Pack
author: Antoine Goumain (Antoinemax)
description: Hi, my name is Antoine. I'm a French Sound Designer. I've created a Sound pack with the theme of nature. Ambient sound (5 sounds) Foliage (6 sounds) Footstep (9 sounds) Stream (3 sounds) Here is my portfolio : https://antoinegoumain.fr/ Here is my LinkedIn : https://www.linkedin.com/in/antoinegoumain/ Here is my Patreon page if you like my work and you want to help me : https://www.patreon.com/antoinegoumain
